newsitem.title: USA: Silicon Gaming sells Odyssey systems.
newsitem.headline: Silicon Gaming sells Odyssey systems.

text.p: Silicon Gaming Inc on Tuesday said casino operator Station Casinos Inc has purchased the 78 Odyssey slot machines originally placed for a 45-day trial period at three Las Vegas properties.

In addition, Station has ordered 122 more Odyssey units. Fifty will be installed at its Sunset Station Hotel & Casino outside Las Vegas, set to open in June. The other 72 units will expand the current Odyssey installations in Las Vegas.
"We are well on track to meet or exceed our original goal to install 400 units this quarter," Silicon Gaming said in a statement.
